The flagged transaction 4012227 ($412.46) triggered a real-time risk score of 0.89 due to billing mismatch [EV-c63e0766]. Transaction 4012227 originated from a new device (Samsung SM-G973F) and an anonymous proxy IP in Argentina [EV-3c5d6577, EV-ce6c5bcb]. The card SC-03019-K957 showed three online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction, with historical average spend of $74.35 [EV-7af7e3e1, EV-a70e6254]. The device profile and customer SC-03019 were each linked to one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4328) [EV-17411851, EV-b2ec3377]. The customer reported not authorizing the purchases and retaining physical possession of the card [EV-b5640397].

sar.narrative: This report documents suspicious activity consistent with account takeover involving customer SC-03019 and card SC-03019-K957. On the date of transaction 4012227, a real-time risk model assigned a score of 0.89 citing billing mismatch and a transaction amount of $412.46, significantly above the card's historical average of $74.35 [EV-c63e0766, EV-7af7e3e1]. The transaction was initiated from a previously unseen device (Samsung SM-G973F) and routed through an anonymous proxy IP geolocated to Argentina [EV-3c5d6577, EV-ce6c5bcb]. Three online transactions occurred on the card within a 48-hour window, indicating rapid successive misuse [EV-a70e6254]. The device fingerprint has been observed in one prior confirmed fraud case, and the customer profile has one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4328) [EV-b2ec3377, EV-17411851]. Pattern retrieval confirms alignment with the account_takeover typology [EV-8289b610]. The customer denies authorizing the transactions and confirms physical card possession, supporting unauthorized use [EV-b5640397]. Total exposure across three transactions is $594.31. The activity warrants SAR filing under applicable regulations.
